label: HealthTech / Digital Health
subject: {{domain}} — your patient portal has accessibility blind spots
body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Scanned {{domain}} for WCAG 2.1 AA compliance and found {{total_issues}} violations — significant for any health platform, where 26% of US adults live with a disability and patient access isn't just good practice, it's increasingly a regulatory expectation.

Three most urgent on {{business_name}}:

1. {{top_issue_1}} — health platforms with inaccessible forms (appointment booking, prescription requests, insurance intake) are among the most ADA-sued digital properties. Every unlabeled field is a patient who can't use your service and a potential complaint.

2. {{top_issue_2}} — medical imagery, test results, and dashboard visualizations that lack text alternatives or proper ARIA descriptions exclude visually impaired patients entirely from their own health data.

3. {{top_issue_3}} — HHS/OCR has signaled that Section 552 (21st Century Cures Act) accessibility requirements will be enforced alongside ADA. Healthtech companies with no accessibility posture face dual exposure.

I can send {{business_name}} a free 17-point accessibility audit (with remediation steps your dev team can execute). No strings attached. For full implementation: flat $1,200, 2-week delivery.

Want me to send the report?

— Emilio Ranucoli
